rc-1.1.summary: Per-repository `coder` in both GitHub modes, and the label set. See RC1.1, RC1.3; §D2.
acceptance: `issue-radar` validates in plans-repo mode; a policy with two equal label names is refused naming both; defaults are `to plan`, `ready`, `crew: in progress`, `merge conflict`; `npm test` passes.

rc-1.2.summary: Plan only the planning label, Untriaged off for Radar-coded repositories. See RC1.2, RC1.5, RC1.8; §D3.
acceptance: No list call for plain open issues is made for a Radar-coded repository (checked with a fake GitHub that records calls); a planning label added by a disallowed account does nothing; the plan-me routing tests of PR 67 still pass unchanged.

rc-1.3.summary: Source issue becomes the parent, planning label cleared only by setting. See RC1.4, RC1.6, RC1.7; §D3.
acceptance: A fake-GitHub test shows the source is the parent, no claim or needs-human write ever happens, and the Needs you row appears once across three ticks.

rc-p1.summary: Proof 1: Avoozl lists only what it was asked to plan. See RC1; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed; a receipt under `docs/evidence/` records setup, action, observation and verdict.

rc-2.1.summary: Plans-repo mode projects issues into the code repository. See RC2.2, RC2.3; §D4.1.
acceptance: With a fake GitHub, single-repo and plans-repo projections write issues only into the code repository; plans-repo with `coder: worker` still writes into the plans repository; closing works in both forms.

rc-2.2.summary: Show the plans repository name in issues, a per-repository switch. See RC2.4; §D4.1.
acceptance: A public code repository with the switch off is refused; turning it on writes the name after a content-rules pass; a private one writes it by default.

rc-2.3.summary: Batch planner for small ready tasks. See RC2.5; §D4.2.
acceptance: Tests cover: blocked tasks never batch; the cap at 3 and at 5; an edge between two tasks splits them; a batch of one stays plain; `flow.batch.max` above 5 is refused.

rc-2.4.summary: Batch issues keep each task ID separate and close together. See RC2.6, RC2.7; §D4.2.
acceptance: A fake merged pull request that closes a three-task batch completes all three tasks; unticked boxes change nothing; the Graph shows the batch node with its members.

rc-2.5.summary: Project to GitHub preview and Spec changed diff. See RC2.1, RC2.8; §D4.3.
acceptance: Nothing is written before the confirm (a fake GitHub records zero writes); a claimed issue is never edited; a removed task closes as not planned; drawn at 320, 768 and 1280 px, light and dark.

rc-2.6.summary: Preflight checks in the preview. See RC2.9; §D4.3.
acceptance: Each failing preflight item refuses Create and release and names the item; a passing run enables it.

rc-p2.summary: Proof 2: spec to issues in both modes. See RC2; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed on real scratch repositories; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-3.1.summary: Provenance marker writer and parser. See RC3.1; §D5.1.
acceptance: Round-trip, unknown key, unknown version, duplicate marker, a space in a value, a bad commit and a path-like value are each tested.

rc-3.2.summary: Approve opens an approval pull request and records the merged commit. See RC3.6, RC3.8; §D5.2.
acceptance: Approving does not change the spec hash; no commit is recorded before the merge; a closed unmerged approval pull request records nothing; a spec with lint errors cannot be approved.

rc-3.3.summary: verify-issue checks: marker, approver, author, spec, commit. See RC3.2–RC3.5; §D5.3.
acceptance: Tests: all ok; each check failing alone, with the others reported; a 404 and a 403 each fail the check; plans-repo reads; `behind`, `ahead`, `diverged` and `identical` compare results; no issue text appears in the output.

rc-3.4.summary: CLI `avoozl verify-issue` and MCP tool `plans_verify_issue`. See RC3.2, RC3.4; §D5.3.
acceptance: Exit codes tested for each case; the command works with no workspace and no token other than the caller's `gh` login; `aicommander verify-issue` works.

rc-3.5.summary: The one-line Additional prompt, shipped verbatim. See RC3.7; §D5.4.
acceptance: A test fails if the constant, `design.md` D5.4 and the Set up text differ.

rc-3.6.summary: Projection writes the marker. See RC2.10, RC3.1; §D5.1.
acceptance: Both modes write a valid marker that `verify-issue` accepts against a fake GitHub; a private name in any value is refused.

rc-p3.summary: Proof 3: a real crew verifies, and each bad issue is refused. See RC3; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-4.1.summary: Release engine: capacity per repository and per scope. See RC4.1, RC4.2, RC4.7; §D6.
acceptance: With N=2 and five eligible tasks, two get the label; claiming one keeps its slot; two scopes release independently; a second tick writes nothing.

rc-4.2.summary: Remove ready on Stop the line, reopen and re-block. See RC4.3; §D6.
acceptance: A claimed issue keeps its labels; unclaimed ones lose ready; the comment is posted once across three ticks.

rc-4.3.summary: Phase gate: release the next phase after the previous one merged. See RC4.4; §D6.
acceptance: A phase with one task closed by order stays held; merging it releases the next phase on the next tick.

rc-4.4.summary: Release mode radio fold-out and the Release queue. See RC4.5, RC4.6; §D6.
acceptance: Step waits for one click per phase; Hold releases nothing; the queue shows the reason for each held item; drawn at 320, 768 and 1280 px.

rc-p4.summary: Proof 4: release honors N, scopes, phases and the stop. See RC4; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.
Each missing item is named; a repository with all three reads ready; `manual` shows a warning only.

rc-5.2.summary: Arm GitHub auto-merge on crew pull requests. See RC5.2, RC5.5; §D7.
acceptance: A fork pull request, a pull request from a stranger, a draft, and one closing an unmarked issue are not armed; the right one is armed exactly once across three ticks.

rc-5.3.summary: Manual mode and the conflict label. See RC5.3, RC5.6, RC5.7; §D7.
acceptance: Manual arms nothing; a conflicted pull request gets the label and one row; resolving it removes both.

rc-5.4.summary: Stop the line stops arming, and Disarm. See RC5.4; §D7.
acceptance: With a stop open a new pull request stays unarmed; Disarm is refused for an agent or app token.
An edited marker blocks arming; an unchanged marker runs the check once across three ticks.

rc-p5.summary: Proof 5: auto-merge on the right pull requests only. See RC5; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-6.1.summary: Ship `avoozl-crew` in the app. See RC6.1, RC6.2, RC6.6; §D8.
acceptance: The built app contains the agent; its tool list holds `plans_verify_issue` and Radar's two crew tools; a build without `bin/lib` is refused with the command to run.

rc-6.2.summary: Crew tools need no workspace and return the brief. See RC6.3; §D8.
acceptance: A call with no workspace succeeds; the brief appears only when every check is ok; no listed tool answers "no workspace".

rc-6.3.summary: Set up verifies the agent is in Radar's Agent list. See RC6.5; §D8.
acceptance: The three outcomes each show a distinct state; a fake Radar list without the agent shows missing.

rc-p6.summary: Proof 6: a crew on avoozl-crew verifies and builds. See RC6; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-7.1.summary: Set up steps through `gh`: labels, branch rule, auto-merge setting. See RC7.1; §D9.
acceptance: Against a fake GitHub each step writes once after confirm; a missing permission writes nothing and names the permission.

rc-7.2.summary: Review-rules pull request to `AGENTS.md`, and the Project. See RC7.1, RC3.7; §D9.
acceptance: The pull request text passes content rules; the Project fields match Requirement 29.

rc-7.3.summary: The Radar values screen and re-read. See RC7.2, RC7.3; §D9.
acceptance: Every value has Copy; the grant path ticks a fake Radar's items; the no-grant path shows checkboxes; drawn at 320, 768 and 1280 px.

rc-7.4.summary: Crews and rules settings in the app's style. See RC7.6; §D9.
acceptance: A UI test fails on "same as above", on a model price field, or on a mode that is not a radio fold-out.

rc-7.5.summary: Team pack with a `crews` section. See RC7.4, RC7.5; §D9.
acceptance: A pack with a private name is refused; applying writes only after the preview confirm; `sdk-team` validates.

rc-p7.summary: Proof 7: Set up end to end. See RC7; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-8.1.summary: Home: On the line, Release queue, Progress by goal, Needs you. See RC8.1, RC8.4, RC8.7; §D10.
acceptance: Rows come from claim markers only; paused, machine and chat are not shown without Variant A; drawn at 320, 768 and 1280 px, light and dark.

rc-8.2.summary: Trace drawer and page. See RC8.2; §D10.
acceptance: A claim marker with `updated=` ahead of GitHub's time still shows GitHub's time; the page opens by URL and Back returns.
Each chat kind shows its content; the URL-shape test exists.

rc-8.4.summary: Flow from GitHub data. See RC8.5; §D10.
acceptance: Stage times computed from fixture events match hand-computed values.

rc-8.5.summary: Retro rule targets: AGENTS.md, steering, Additional prompt text. See RC8.6; §D10.
acceptance: Applying a repo rule opens a pull request; the prompt target writes nothing to Radar; the check runs after N issues.

rc-8.6.summary: Variant A: Radar's crew list through one grant. See RC8.1; §D10.
acceptance: Without the grant nothing changes; with it, crews and counts show.

rc-p8.summary: Proof 8: observe, and a retro rule a crew follows. See RC8; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-9.1.summary: Planner chat, proposal shape and promote rules. See RC9.1, RC9.4; §D11.
acceptance: A proposal with a task lacking evidence is refused; each promote rule triggers alone; the budget stops the chat.

rc-9.2.summary: Mini-spec writer and approval. See RC9.3, RC9.5; §D11.
acceptance: The folder lints with 0 errors; a private name in the prompt is removed or refused; the marker passes `verify-issue`.

rc-9.3.summary: Quick goal modal, proposal screen, Promote to spec. See RC9.1, RC9.2, RC9.4, RC9.6; §D11.
acceptance: Nothing is written before Approve; Promote keeps task IDs and issue links; drawn at 320, 768 and 1280 px.

rc-p9.summary: Proof 9: Make tests faster. See RC9; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-10.1.summary: Hold release for a public repository until the public sign-off is complete. See RC10.1, RC10.2; §D12.
acceptance: A public repository with no sign-off releases nothing and says why; once that work lands the check reads its sign-off.

rc-10.2.summary: verify-issue output is safe to post. See RC10.3, RC10.4; §D12.
acceptance: The test fails when a path prints text from an issue; the release scan finds nothing.
Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-q3.summary: Q3: note for Kiro Crew asking for `scope=` in the claim marker. See RC12.2, RC12.4; §D16.
acceptance: The note exists and says exactly what key and why; the report names the release checked.

rc-q4.summary: Q4: re-check the `updated=` time on a later release. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report states the release, the five differences and whether stale detection may use `updated=`.

rc-q5.summary: Q5: a crew with no access to the plans repository. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report states the result and either closes Q5 or proposes the mirror task.

rc-q6.summary: Q6: does a crew take a mini-spec issue. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report states the result and whether a decision record or Promote is required.

rc-q7.summary: Q7: does the one-line prompt make the decision record unnecessary. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report states the result and sets `approval.decisionRecord`'s default.

rc-q8.summary: Q8: the plans repository name in a public marker. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report states the choice: switch on, or spec moved into the code repository.

rc-q9.summary: Q9: the default label names. See RC12.2; §D16.
acceptance: The report lists each label, its source and the decision; defaults in `rc-1.1` match.

rc-p11.summary: Proof 11: the whole path on a real repository, Q1 and Q2. See RC11.1, RC12; §D16, D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live and accepted by a person; receipt under `docs/evidence/`. Q1 and Q2 are answered in it.

rc-12.1.summary: Owner decision to retire, and what to keep. See RC11.1, RC11.3; §D13.
acceptance: A recorded owner decision exists before any removal task starts.

rc-12.2.summary: Switch off worker dispatch for Radar-coded repositories. See RC11.2, RC11.3; §D13.
acceptance: A Radar-coded repository opens no worker; a worker-coded one still does.

rc-12.3.summary: Retire crew routing and placement for Radar-coded repositories. See RC11.2; §D13.
acceptance: No routing call is made for a Radar-coded repository; the Routing section is hidden only when no repository needs it.
`npm test` passes; the removed names appear nowhere in the app.

rc-12.5.summary: Retire the remote relay. See RC11.2; §D13.
acceptance: `npm test` passes; the relay agent is not in the built app.

rc-12.6.summary: Retire per-task worker budgets and the worker Files and diff fold. See RC11.2; §D13.
acceptance: Budgets still cap a planner chat; the drawer has no Files fold for a Radar-coded task.

rc-12.7.summary: Compatibility test: names and aliases that must stay. See RC11.4; §D13.
acceptance: The test fails if any listed name stops working.

rc-12.8.summary: Docs and Demo retargeted to crews. See RC11.7, RC8.1; §D13.
acceptance: The docs name each path once; the release scan is clean; a diff check shows no change under `docs/research/` or `docs/evidence/` except new receipts.

rc-p12.summary: Proof 12: after retirement both coders work. See RC11; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-13.1.summary: Scope statement in the README, Set up and the quick goal modal. See RC13.1, RC13.2, RC13.5; §D18.
acceptance: The three places show the same words from one string; no operation changes behavior; `npm test` passes.

rc-13.2.summary: One-pull-request hint with Plan it anyway. See RC13.3, RC13.4; §D18.
acceptance: A one-task proposal shows the hint and still plans when chosen; a two-task proposal shows no hint.

rc-p13.summary: Proof 13: the work split. See RC13; §D22.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-14.1.summary: Per-repository coder setting with three values. See RC14.1; §D19.
acceptance: Each value validates; an unknown value is refused naming the allowed ones; Settings shows the three display names; `npm test` passes.

rc-14.2.summary: Coder adapter: hand over, read state, count as done. See RC14.2, RC14.3, RC14.6; §D19.
acceptance: The Radar tests of Phases 4 and 5 pass unchanged; a fake third adapter in a test needs no change to release or projection; done is true only for a merged pull request.

rc-14.3.summary: Put the worker behind the adapter and mark it frozen. See RC14.4; §D19.
acceptance: Existing worker tests pass unchanged; Settings says frozen; no new option is added to the worker.

rc-14.4.summary: Coder change with tasks in flight. See RC14.5; §D19.
acceptance: A test switches coder with one task in flight: that task finishes with the old coder, the next goes to the new one, one notice appears.

rc-p14.summary: Proof 14: the same plan, any coder. See RC14; §D22.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-15.1.summary: Remote coder adapter: file one task per ready task or batch. See RC15.2, RC15.3, RC15.7, RC15.9; §D20.
acceptance: A fake harness receives one task per ready task and one per batch; a retried tick files nothing twice; nothing the content rules mark private is sent.

rc-15.2.summary: Watch the remote task and count done only on a public merge. See RC15.3, RC15.4, RC15.8; §D20.
acceptance: A fake harness that says complete with no pull request leaves the task not done; the merge of the public pull request releases dependents; a read failure shows the age and changes nothing.

rc-15.3.summary: Needs you row for a waiting publish, and larger batches. See RC15.5, RC15.6; §D20.
acceptance: The row appears once across three ticks and clears on the pull request; the preview shows the publish count; a chain that fits one batch is batched whole.

rc-15.4.summary: No internal names in the repository, and a scan check. See RC15.1; §D20.
acceptance: A test with a pattern set in the environment fails when a listed name appears in a tracked file; `node scripts/release-scan.mjs --tree` is clean.

rc-p15.summary: Proof 15: a remote coder end to end with a fake harness. See RC15; §D22.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-16.1.summary: Integration branch in the manifest, with branch checks. See RC16.1, RC16.9; §D21.
acceptance: A missing, unprotected or default branch is refused naming the reason; a manifest without the field changes nothing.

rc-16.2.summary: Projected tasks target the branch, and the branch merge path. See RC16.2; §D21.
acceptance: A pull request into main for a branch epic fails `verify-issue`; a pull request into the branch passes and may be armed.

rc-16.3.summary: Whole-head checks on the branch and acceptance records. See RC16.3, RC16.5, RC16.8; §D21.
acceptance: A green task merge leaves acceptance open; a green head records acceptance for that head; a new merge makes the record name the new head.

rc-16.4.summary: Scheduled merge of main into the branch. See RC16.6; §D21.
acceptance: A test repository gets a merge commit and a normal push; a conflict leaves the branch unchanged and raises the row; the sync code contains no force option.

rc-16.5.summary: Stop the line for the branch. See RC16.7; §D21.
acceptance: A red head stops release and arming; clearing it resumes both.

rc-16.6.summary: Landing the branch in main: one person-approved step. See RC16.4, RC16.5; §D21.
acceptance: No code path merges the branch into the default branch; an approval on an old head is refused; the row records approver and head.

rc-p16.summary: Proof 16: a rewrite on an integration branch. See RC16; §D22.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-17.1.summary: Templates and docs: rewrite, cross-repository migration, large codegen change. See RC17.1, RC17.2, RC17.3, RC17.7; §D22.
acceptance: Each template lints with 0 errors; the release scan finds no internal name.

rc-17.2.summary: Cross-repository proposal: parent spec and one sub-spec per repository. See RC17.4, RC17.5; §D22.
acceptance: A parent with a repository task is refused; a `requires` on a missing ID is refused naming it; two sub-specs approve separately.

rc-17.3.summary: External gap report becomes proposed tasks. See RC17.6; §D22.
acceptance: A fixture report with two failing and three passing cells gives two proposals; an unreadable line is refused naming it; accepting adds the tasks.
Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-15.5.summary: Start the harness's MCP server as a child process; file under the approver. See RC15.10, RC15.11; §D20.
acceptance: A test with a fake MCP server shows only those two tools are called and the process ends with the tick; the receipt holds approver, harness task ID and Avoozl task IDs; no other identity is used.

rc-15.6.summary: Expired sign-in: one Needs you item and no retry loop. See RC15.12; §D20.
acceptance: A fake harness that refuses the sign-in causes one item across five ticks and no filing attempts beyond one check per tick; filing resumes and the item clears after sign-in.

rc-18.1.summary: Approval label setting and label clash check. See RC18.1; §D23.
acceptance: The default validates; a clash is refused naming both labels; `npm test` passes.

rc-18.2.summary: Tick reads the approval label and checks the labeler. See RC18.2, RC18.3, RC18.7; §D23.
acceptance: A fake GitHub test: an allowed labeler approves; a stranger's label is removed with one row across three ticks; a label removal after approval changes nothing.

rc-18.3.summary: One approval record, with write-back to the issue. See RC18.4, RC18.5, RC18.6, RC18.8, RC18.9; §D23.
acceptance: Three fake-GitHub tests: each path gives one record; a second approval writes nothing; a failed write-back leaves the approval and one row.

rc-p18.summary: Proof 18: approve on the issue. See RC18; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-19.1.summary: Claim the parent at approval. See RC19.1, RC19.2, RC19.3, RC19.4, RC19.5, RC19.6; §D24.
acceptance: A fake-GitHub test: the parent gets one claim and label; a parent with a crew's claim gets no write and one Trace note; a second approval writes nothing; a superseded plan removes only Avoozl's claim.

rc-p19.summary: Proof 19: the parent is not taken by a crew. See RC19; §D17.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

rc-20.1.summary: Avoozl's label names: `avoozl:` defaults, review and drafted labels, clash check, Settings. See RC21; §D26.
acceptance: An unset policy resolves the six `avoozl:` defaults; a policy that sets `to plan` keeps it; review equal to drafted, or to the claim label, is refused naming both; the UI test shows the six fields with their defaults as placeholders; `npm test` passes.

rc-20.2.summary: Review label on a pull request opens one read-only review chat. See RC20.1, RC20.2, RC20.3, RC20.10, RC20.14; §D25.
acceptance: Fake-GitHub tests: an allowed labeler with a matching login gives one dispatch across three ticks; a stranger's label is removed with one row; a login mismatch gives no dispatch and one row; the brief names the crew claim and the spec task.

rc-20.3.summary: `plans_post_review_draft`: a pending review with line comments, then the label swap. See RC20.4, RC20.5, RC20.9, RC20.13, RC20.14; §D25.
acceptance: Fake-GitHub tests: the create call has no `event` and the head commit; a second call posts nothing; a screen hit posts nothing; a redraft deletes only Avoozl's earlier draft; a grep test finds no submit or dismiss path.

rc-20.4.summary: Waiting, stale and submitted drafts: rows, the Review drafts list, the search link and Trace. See RC20.6, RC20.7, RC20.8, RC20.11, RC20.12; §D25.
acceptance: Fake-GitHub tests: a submitted draft clears the label and row once; a deleted draft is recorded as discarded; a head move marks stale and deletes nothing; the UI test shows the list, the filter and the search link; Trace shows Review only for a drafted pull request.

rc-p20.summary: Proof 20: a review draft from a label. See RC20, RC21; §D25.
acceptance: Expected result observed live; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.
